question: On Agreeing to the Amendment (H R 7567)
bill_title: Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026
plain_language: This amendment to H.R. 7567 (Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026) is summarized by the Congressional Research Service as: “Amendment removes certain emissions standards on farm equipment.” A Yea supports adding it to the bill; a Nay opposes it.

question: On Agreeing to the Amendment (H R 7567)
bill_title: Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026
plain_language: This amendment to H.R. 7567 (Farm, Food, and National Security Act of 2026) is summarized by the Congressional Research Service as: “Amendment sought to add "soda" to the definition of ineligible items and defines soda as a carbonated beverage containing more than 1 gram of added sugar, artificial sweetener, or flavoring per serving.” A Yea supports adding it to the bill; a Nay opposes it.
